zero_event_finding.close_price_impact: none measured: adjusted close still matches type7 exactly on the zero-event symbol, because its q is 1 on every day
zero_event_finding.hypothesis_from_source: measuredFactorEvents returns measured=false on an empty factor set (measured.go:42-44), so a reference-covered zero-event symbol takes the pack/official fallback instead of the measured chain
zero_event_finding.mechanism: ChartDB (backend-go/internal/chart/handlers.go:37-42) applies literalDisplayCandles whenever measuredFactorEvents reports measured=false, AFTER price_basis and FTS. literalDisplayCandles (backend-go/internal/chart/corrections.go:747-752) unconditionally resets high=high_raw and low=low_raw, discarding the widening that both referenceRawHistory (candle.Widen) and pricebasis.ApplyBasis had applied, then overlays the versioned pack's raw field corrections. The handler's own comment states the intent: a symbol covered by reference factors keeps its own type0 series and must NOT receive the pack's display correction. Coverage is inferred from len(factor rows)>0, so a covered symbol with zero events is treated as uncovered and does receive it.
zero_event_finding.owner_ruling_required: whether coverage should be detected from reference_raw presence rather than from a non-empty factor set is a product/row-selection decision. This mission may not rewrite measured.go or the handler without a new technical reason and an owner ruling.
zero_event_finding.product_consequence: the served candle can have open outside its own high/low, i.e. a body protruding past the shadow. Counted per symbol as served_geometry_invalid_rows; this is a visible chart defect, not a close-price error.
